\chapter{I Got Up Early}
\label{ch:pa-a2-uthia}
\hlchaptermodality{218}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can say that I got up or sat down, and that I did not go, with past forms that agree with me.}

Say you got up and sat down with -ia or -i, and say what you did not do with nahin before a past form.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਉੱਠਣਾ} · \pa{ਬੈਠਣਾ} · \pa{ਆਇਆ} (uṭṭhṇā · baiṭhṇā …)}{ਉੱਠਣਾ · ਬੈਠਣਾ · ਆਇਆ (uṭṭhṇā · baiṭhṇā …)}]{Return to getting up and sitting}

\label{lesson:PA-C218-body-return}



\begin{quote}
\emph{Hear:} \emph{uṭṭhṇā; baiṭhṇā} Say \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠਣਾ} · \pa{ਬੈਠਣਾ}}. Then \emph{Aman came yesterday}.
\end{quote}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={Grammar Lens}]
You already say \textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਅਮਨ} \pa{ਨੂੰ} \pa{ਮਿਲਿਆ}}, \textquotedblleft{}I met Aman\textquotedblright{}. Listen to its end: \emph{-iā}, the same sound that ends \textbf{\pa{ਆਇਆ}}. The next lesson gives that ending to getting up and sitting down.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{to get up} Say \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠਣਾ}}.
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{to sit} Say \textbf{\pa{ਬੈਠਣਾ}}.
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{I met Aman} Say \textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਅਮਨ} \pa{ਨੂੰ} \pa{ਮਿਲਿਆ}}.
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Say \emph{please get up}, then \emph{please sit}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ} · \pa{ਬੈਠਿਆ} (uṭṭhiā · baiṭhiā)}{ਉੱਠਿਆ · ਬੈਠਿਆ (uṭṭhiā · baiṭhiā)}]{\pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ}, \pa{ਬੈਠਿਆ} — got up, sat down}

\label{lesson:PA-C218-uthia}



\begin{quote}
Say \emph{to get up}, \emph{to sit}, then \emph{I met Aman}.
\end{quote}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={Grammar Lens: stem + \pa{ਿਆ}, stem + \pa{ੀ}}]
Most stems make their past by adding \textbf{\pa{ਿਆ}} for a man and \textbf{\pa{ੀ}} for a woman:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠ}} + \textbf{\pa{ਿਆ}} $\to$ \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ}} · \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠ}} + \textbf{\pa{ੀ}} $\to$ \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠੀ}}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਸਵੇਰੇ} \pa{ਜਲਦੀ} \pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ।}} — \emph{maiṁ savere jaldī uṭṭhiā.} — I got up early in the morning (a man speaking).
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਸਵੇਰੇ} \pa{ਜਲਦੀ} \pa{ਉੱਠੀ।}} — \emph{maiṁ savere jaldī uṭṭhī.} — I got up early in the morning (a woman speaking).
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਉਹ} \pa{ਇੱਥੇ} \pa{ਬੈਠਿਆ।}} — \emph{uh itthe baiṭhiā.} — He sat here.
\end{quote}

Getting up and sitting are done by you, not to anything, so the ending agrees with you.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{she sat here} Say \textbf{\pa{ਉਹ} \pa{ਇੱਥੇ} \pa{ਬੈਠੀ।}}
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{Aman got up early} Say \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ} \pa{ਜਲਦੀ} \pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ।}}
  \item \emph{Read it:} \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ}} Point to \textbf{\pa{ਿਆ}} after the stem.
  \item \emph{Write it:} copy \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ}} and \textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠੀ}} once
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
\emph{Got up}, for a man? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ}}.) For a woman? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਠੀ}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ} · \pa{ਉੱਠੀ} … (uṭṭhiā · uṭṭhī …)}{ਉੱਠਿਆ · ਉੱਠੀ … (uṭṭhiā · uṭṭhī …)}]{Hear and say got up again}

\label{lesson:PA-C218-uthia-review}



\begin{quote}
\emph{Hear:} \emph{uṭṭhiā; uṭṭhī; baiṭhiā; baiṭhī} Say all four.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{I got up early in the morning} Say it with the ending that fits you.
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{the woman came and sat here} Say \textbf{\pa{ਔਰਤ} \pa{ਆਈ} \pa{ਅਤੇ} \pa{ਇੱਥੇ} \pa{ਬੈਠੀ।}}
  \item \emph{Read it:} \textbf{\pa{ਉਹ} \pa{ਇੱਥੇ} \pa{ਬੈਠਿਆ।}} Give its meaning.
  \item \emph{Write it:} cover the model and write \textbf{\pa{ਬੈਠੀ}} once
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Say when you got up this morning: early, or not.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਗਿਆ।} (maiṁ nahīṁ giā.)}{ਮੈਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਗਿਆ। (maiṁ nahīṁ giā.)}]{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਗਿਆ} — I didn't go}

\label{lesson:PA-C218-nahin-gia}



\begin{quote}
Say \emph{I don't drink tea}. Then \emph{Aman went to school}.
\end{quote}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={Grammar Lens: \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} before the past}]
\textbf{\pa{ਨਹੀਂ}} goes before the past form, as before any verb. A past like this has no helper to keep:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਕੱਲ੍ਹ} \pa{ਸਕੂਲ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਗਿਆ।}} — \emph{maiṁ kallh sakūl nahīṁ giā.} — I didn't go to school yesterday (a man speaking).
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਕੱਲ੍ਹ} \pa{ਸਕੂਲ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਗਈ।}} — \emph{maiṁ kallh sakūl nahīṁ gaī.} — I didn't go to school yesterday (a woman speaking).
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\pa{ਉਹ} \pa{ਜਲਦੀ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ।}} — \emph{uh jaldī nahīṁ uṭṭhiā.} — He didn't get up early.
\end{quote}
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{Aman didn't come yesterday} Say \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ} \pa{ਕੱਲ੍ਹ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਆਇਆ।}}
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{she didn't sit} Say \textbf{\pa{ਉਹ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਬੈਠੀ।}}
  \item \emph{Read it:} \textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਕੱਲ੍ਹ} \pa{ਸਕੂਲ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਗਿਆ।}} Point to \textbf{\pa{ਨਹੀਂ}}, then to the past form.
  \item \emph{Write it:} copy \textbf{\pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਗਿਆ}} once
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Say one place you went yesterday, and one place you didn't.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਸਵੇਰੇ} \pa{ਜਲਦੀ} \pa{ਉੱਠਿਆ।} (maiṁ savere …)}{ਮੈਂ ਸਵੇਰੇ ਜਲਦੀ ਉੱਠਿਆ। (maiṁ savere …)}]{This morning: a four-skill payoff}

\label{lesson:PA-C218-payoff}



\begin{quote}
Say \emph{I got up early}, then \emph{I didn't go to school}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn: four skills}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{I got up early in the morning} Say it with the ending that fits you.
  \item \emph{Hear:} \emph{Aman didn't come yesterday} Say \textbf{\pa{ਅਮਨ} \pa{ਕੱਲ੍ਹ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਆਇਆ।}}
  \item \emph{Read it:} \textbf{\pa{ਉਹ} \pa{ਜਲਦੀ} \pa{ਨਹੀਂ} \pa{ਉੱਠੀ।}} Give its meaning: she didn't get up early.
  \item \emph{Write it:} cover the line and write \textbf{\pa{ਮੈਂ} \pa{ਇੱਥੇ} \pa{ਬੈਠਿਆ।}} or its woman's form
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Tell your morning in two lines: when you got up, and where you didn't go.
\end{tcolorbox}
